statusHelp.unmodified: Taken with the Vireek camera while online. The file is identical to what the server received.
statusHelp.imported: Not taken with the in-app camera (gallery or browser upload). Only integrity since upload is proven.
statusHelp.offline: Taken without a connection. The time shown is the device clock, not a verified time.
statusHelp.integrity_failed: The file or its record no longer matches the sealed evidence chain. Do not rely on it.

note.integrityFailed: The evidence record does not match its seal.
note.notFromAppCamera: Not captured by the in-app camera.
note.offlineDeviceTime: Captured offline: the capture time is the device clock.

deviceTime.missing: The device did not report a capture time.
deviceTime.future: The device clock was ahead of the server. Its time is not trusted.
deviceTime.stale: The device clock was more than 30 days behind the server. Its time is not trusted.

note.clockSkew: The device clock differs from the server time by more than 5 minutes.

locationAccuracy.high: Location recorded, accuracy about 20 m or better.
locationAccuracy.low: Location recorded, accuracy worse than 100 m.

location.policy_off: No location: photo location is switched off for this account.
location.consent_not_configured: No location: technician consent is not set up for this account.
location.no_consent: No location: the technician had not consented.
location.off_duty: No location: the technician was off duty.
location.outside_job_window: No location: the photo was outside the job time window.
location.invalid: No location: the reading was invalid.

note.hasRedactedCopy: A redacted copy exists. Redaction changes the pixels; the original stays on record.

summary.heading: Verified photo summary (Vireek evidence chain)
summary.counts: {{total}} photos: {{unmodified}} unmodified since capture, {{imported}} imported, {{offline}} offline captures, {{integrityFailed}} failed integrity checks.

limits.title: What this does and does not prove
limits.proves: It proves the photo file has not changed since the server received it, and records when and how it was captured.
limits.doesNot: It does not prove the work was done correctly, or that the photo shows what it is claimed to show.
limits.spoofing: The device clock and GPS can be spoofed. Photos taken outside the app camera carry no capture guarantee.
limits.summary: Limits: this proves integrity since the server received the photo, not that the work was done correctly. Device time and GPS can be spoofed.

capture.failed: The photo could not be saved.
capture.unsupported: This image type is not supported. Use JPEG, PNG, WebP or HEIC.

settings.counsel: Tracking technicians can be regulated by labor and privacy law where you operate. Have counsel review before you enable it.
